description: NETWORK DEVELOPMENT PROGRAM - CONSTRUCTION OF BY-PASS AND DIVERSION ROADS - BALAGTAS DIVERSION ROAD, BALAGTAS, BULACAN
colour_meaning: Review: one strong sign of risk, or two weaker ones.
contractor: C & F Construction & Development Corporation (winning bidder)

bidders.name: Sto. Cristo Construction & Trading Inc. (For: Sto. Cristo Construction & Trading)

reasons.title: A bidder had a contract terminated before
reasons.detail: C & F Construction & Development Corporation (winner): 2 of 153 earlier road contracts terminated; L.R. Tiqui Builders, Inc.: 5 of 155 earlier road contracts terminated; Sto. Cristo Construction & Trading Inc. (For: Sto. Cristo Construction & Trading): 1 of 135 earlier road contracts terminated
reasons.evidence: In past contracts, a winner with an earlier termination had about 2.1 times the odds of another; this held on 2023–2025 data.
checks: Open the terminated contracts listed under Bidders and see why they ended (COA report, DPWH order).
Check whether the firm with the termination record is the winner.

reasons.title: Very fast award after bid opening
reasons.detail: Award made 7 days after the bid deadline (past road contracts awarded this fast had about twice the odds of termination)
reasons.evidence: Awards within 8 days of bid opening had about 2.1 times the odds of termination.
checks: Compare the bid-opening date with the Notice of Award date.
Ask whether post-qualification (checking the winner's documents and capacity) could be done that fast.

reasons.title: The winner's other projects drew citizen reports
reasons.detail: C & F CONSTRUCTION & DEVELOPMENT CORPORATION has 3 other DPWH projects reported by citizens (ghost/defective/unfinished tags)
reasons.evidence: A contractor whose other roads drew 2+ citizen reports had about 4.5 times the odds of a report.
checks: Open the winner's reported projects on the DPWH Transparency Portal and read what citizens reported.
Plan a site visit or ask a local monitor (Bisto Proyekto, TAPAT) to look once work starts.

tests.text: L.R. TIQUI BUILDERS, INC.: named in the 2025-26 flood-control investigations (officer: Luisito R. Tiqui, subpoenaed)
